changelog: **Adjacency-weighted skill matching in mentor suggestions and requisition alerts (#1821, epic #1810):** one exported scorer, `skillOverlap()` in `src/lib/skillTaxonomyRule.ts` (pure, unit-tested; for the matching engine #1781/#1787 too), covers each target skill directly (1) or through the holder's best one-hop `SkillEdge` neighbour (its weight). `/api/admin/mentor-suggest` ranks on it — exact React beats a Frontend-only mentor, who still scores the edge weight — and returns `adjacentSkills` (`{ skill, via, weight }`) next to `sharedSkills`, rendered by `AssignMentorInline` as "Frontend (related to React)"; a mentee with no canonical skills falls back to the old free-text match. The AI re-rank payload, quota gate and `aiUsed: false` fallback are unchanged; `MATCH_RULESET_VERSION` is now `rules-v2`. The premium `checkCompanyNeedMatches` alert matches a requisition with required skills through `requisitionSkillMatch()` — at least min(2, required) of its `RequisitionSkill` rows covered, adjacency ≥ 0.5 — so "Go" no longer matches a "Django" title; a requisition without skills compares its title with the target position only, and CompanyNeed keeps its old heuristic. The alert e-mail is now in the recipient's language (EN/TR/DE) and names the matching skills.

en: Mentor suggestions now understand related skills — a mentee who knows React is also shown mentors with Frontend experience, ranked below an exact match and labelled as related.
Open-position alerts for companies now match on the role's required skills and list which skills matched.
tr: Mentor önerileri artık ilişkili becerileri anlıyor — React bilen bir mentee'ye Frontend deneyimli mentorlar da gösteriliyor; tam eşleşmenin altında ve “ilişkili” olarak işaretli.
Firmalara giden açık pozisyon uyarıları artık pozisyonun gerekli becerilerine göre eşleşiyor ve hangi becerilerin eşleştiğini listeliyor.
de: Mentor-Vorschläge verstehen jetzt verwandte Skills — wer React kann, sieht auch Mentor:innen mit Frontend-Erfahrung, unterhalb eines exakten Treffers und als verwandt markiert.
Hinweise auf offene Stellen für Unternehmen gleichen jetzt die geforderten Skills der Stelle ab und nennen die passenden Skills.
